disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is unusually strong and broad: congressional net buying and lobbying are each at z=3.5, joined by material 8-K events at z=1.523 and a positive regulatory pipeline across four sources [P3]. Persistence is plausible because several independent channels are strengthening simultaneously, but the theme is still forming and has no supporting news leg, limiting confidence [P1][P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative performance is -6.11% versus the market, while the activity-price divergence is strongly positive at z=2.676 [P2][P4]. That combination supports ENTER because activity is leading rather than chasing price, with medium confidence until price or news confirms.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号强且来源广泛：国会议员净买入和游说活动均为 z=3.5，同时还有重大 8-K 事件和正向监管进展，共覆盖四类来源 [P3]。多个独立渠道同时增强，说明活动可能持续，但主题仍处形成期，且没有新闻面配合，因此信心受限 [P1][P5]。价格尚未确认：过去60天相对大盘落后6.11%，而活动领先价格的偏离达到 z=2.676 [P2][P4]。因此活动先于价格的格局支持 ENTER，但在价格或新闻确认前仅给予中等信心。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying, corporate disclosures and regulatory activity are all picking up across memory and storage companies. Prices have not followed yet, with the group trailing the market by about 6% over the past 60 days. That gap creates an attractive early-entry setup, although the absence of supporting news means conviction should remain moderate until prices begin responding.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 存储芯片和存储设备企业相关的政府人员买入、游说、公司重大披露及监管活动都在升温。相关公司过去60天仍落后大盘约6%，价格尚未跟上这些变化。当前差距提供了较早介入的机会，但由于缺少新闻面的配合，在价格开始响应前仍应保持适度谨慎。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the theme is only forming, has no news support, and continues to underperform the market; the activity surge could therefore be temporary or fail to translate into investor demand [P1][P4][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm if subsequent readings show activity remaining positive across several of the four sources and 60-day relative performance improves from the current -6.11% toward or above the market [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm if congressional buying and lobbying retreat from their current z=3.5 readings without stronger corporate or regulatory follow-through, while relative performance remains negative or deteriorates [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong and broad: Congress net buying is exceptionally elevated (z=3.5), lobbying is also surging (z=2.849), and the combined acceleration is 2.819 across three sources [P3]. Durability is promising but not proven because the theme is still forming, material 8-K events are slightly negative, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative strength is -6.72%, while the activity-price divergence is strongly positive at 2.454, creating an activity-led entry setup rather than a momentum-confirmed one [P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号较强且来源较广：国会议员净买入显著升高，游说活动也在快速增加，三个来源的综合加速度达到2.819 [P3]。持续性具有潜力但尚未得到充分验证，因为主题仍处于形成阶段，重大8-K事件信号略为负面，而且没有新闻流配合 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未跟上：过去60天相对大盘落后6.72%，而现实活动明显领先价格，因此更像是活动先行的布局机会，而非已获市场动量确认的趋势 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Political buying and lobbying activity around payments and financial-technology companies are rising strongly, with several independent sources contributing. Prices have not followed yet—the group has lagged the market by about 6.7% over the past 60 days—so this looks like an early opportunity rather than an established trend. A measured entry is reasonable, but conviction should remain moderate because corporate event filings are soft and there is no supporting news flow.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 支付与金融科技公司的政治相关买入和游说活动正在明显增加，而且不止一个来源在增强。相关公司过去60天落后大盘约6.7%，价格尚未跟上，因此这更像是早期机会，而不是已经确立的趋势。可以适度布局，但由于公司重大事项信号偏弱、新闻流也未形成配合，信心不宜过高。
assessments.dissent: The apparent surge may be transient or politically driven rather than evidence of improving business conditions: material 8-K activity is negative, no news trend supports the move, and the theme is only forming [P1][P3][P5]. Continued price underperformance could therefore reflect genuine weakness rather than delayed recognition [P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Over the next observation window, congressional buying and lobbying remain elevated or strengthen, material-event activity turns positive, and the covered group begins outperforming the market [P3][P4][P6].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The congressional-buying or lobbying surge reverses without material-event or news confirmation, while the covered group continues to underperform the market [P3][P4][P5][P6].

assessments.name: Payments & Fintech

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately strong but concentrated: government-contract activity is elevated at z=1.593, while congressional net buying is negative, lobbying is flat, and material 8-K events are slightly negative [P3]. Persistence is uncertain because the signal is still forming [P1], relies chiefly on one of four sources [P3], and has no supporting news leg [P5]. Activity is modestly ahead of price (divergence z=0.43), but 60-day relative performance is essentially neutral to slightly negative, so price has not yet confirmed the narrative [P2][P4]. This supports MONITOR rather than ENTER until activity broadens or price begins to respond.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号中等偏强，但主要集中在政府合同：该项为1.593，而国会议员净买入为负、游说活动持平、重大8-K事件略为负面[P3]。持续性仍不明确，因为信号尚处形成阶段[P1]，四类来源中主要只有一类提供明显支持[P3]，且没有新闻推动[P5]。活动领先价格的幅度仅为0.43，而过去60天相对大盘表现基本持平、略偏弱，价格尚未确认这一叙事[P2][P4]。因此目前更适合观察，等待活动扩散或价格开始响应。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting activity is picking up, but congressional buying, corporate disclosures, and lobbying do not provide matching support. Prices have not meaningfully followed, and there is no reinforcing news flow, so the move may be early or too narrowly based. Keep it on a watchlist and wait for either broader real-world participation or clearer price improvement.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同活动正在升温，但国会议员买入、公司重大披露和游说活动并未同步增强。价格尚未明显跟进，也没有新闻推动，因此这股变化可能仍处早期，或支持面过窄。适合继续观察，等待更多现实活动共同转强或价格出现更清晰的改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that fused acceleration is high at 1.406 and government-contract activity is particularly strong, while activity already leads price; that combination could mark an early opportunity before market confirmation arrives [P2][P3].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if subsequent readings show positive contributions from multiple currently weak sources—especially congressional buying, lobbying, or material events—while relative performance turns decisively positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the narrative if government-contract activity falls back without improvement in the other sources and relative performance remains flat or deteriorates [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Activity is narrow rather than broadly strong: Congress net buying is exceptional at 3.5, but lobbying is flat and material 8-K events are below baseline at -0.546 [P3]. Persistence looks weak because the theme is classified as fading, has no supporting news leg, and its modest fused acceleration of 0.152 depends mainly on one of three sources [P1][P3][P5]. Price has already run well ahead: 60-day relative strength is 0.2777 with a 2.635 standardized reading, while the activity-versus-price divergence is -1.575, producing a negative divergence [P2][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号较为集中：国会净买入读数高达3.5，但游说活动没有增长，重大8-K事件低于常态，为-0.546 [P3]。持续性偏弱，因为主题已进入衰退阶段、没有新闻支持，而且0.152的综合加速度主要依赖三个来源中的单一强项 [P1][P3][P5]。价格已明显跑在实际活动之前：60日相对强度为0.2777，标准化读数达2.635，而活动相对价格的背离为-1.575，形成负向背离 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Lawmakers’ buying is unusually strong, but lobbying is flat and companies are reporting fewer material events than usual. Meanwhile, prices have already risen sharply relative to the market, without supporting news or broadly improving business activity. The theme appears to be losing momentum, so it is better avoided until corporate and lobbying signals catch up.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 国会议员买入活动异常强劲，但游说活动没有增长，企业披露的重大事件也少于常态。与此同时，相关公司股价已经明显跑赢大盘，却缺少新闻和更广泛经营活动的支持。整体动能正在减弱，宜暂时回避，等待企业活动与游说信号真正跟上。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that exceptional Congress net buying and positive fused acceleration could be an early signal that broader activity will improve later, while strong relative price performance may reflect informed anticipation rather than exhaustion [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the avoidance call if the next observation still shows flat lobbying and below-baseline material events, while activity remains behind price and the fading classification persists [P1][P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if lobbying and material-event activity both turn meaningfully positive, lifting the multi-source acceleration while the activity-versus-price divergence moves above zero rather than relying primarily on Congress buying [P2][P3].

assessments.name: Non-AI Software

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak: government contracts and congressional net buying are below baseline, while lobbying, solicitations, material events, and normalized news activity are essentially flat [P3]. Persistence looks doubtful because the theme is classified as fading and activity trails price materially [P1][P2]. Price has nevertheless outperformed the market over 60 days, indicating that market enthusiasm is running ahead of the measured activity [P4]. Unscheduled and accelerating news plus positive fused acceleration provide a counter-signal, but this has not yet translated into broad source confirmation [P3][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实际活动信号偏弱：政府合同和国会净买入均低于基准，而游说、招标、重大事件及标准化新闻活动基本持平[P3]。持续性存疑，因为主题正在减弱，而且实际活动明显落后于价格[P1][P2]。价格过去60天仍跑赢大盘，说明市场热度领先于可观察到的实际活动[P4]。突发新闻增多且整体加速度为正，构成反向证据，但尚未获得多个来源的实质确认[P3][P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting and congressional buying have weakened, while lobbying, procurement requests and corporate event activity remain mostly flat. Prices have still outperformed the market, suggesting enthusiasm has moved ahead of the underlying activity. Faster, largely unexpected news offers some upside potential, but for now the theme looks better avoided until real-world demand improves across several channels.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同活动和国会相关买入都在减弱，而游说、采购需求和企业重大事项基本没有增长。相关公司的价格仍跑赢大盘，说明市场热度已经走在实际活动之前。突发消息增多带来一定上行可能，但在多个渠道出现明确改善前，更适合回避。
assessments.dissent: The bearish reading may be early: 60-day relative performance is positive, fused activity acceleration is positive, and news velocity and acceleration are both 0.6 with all observed news unscheduled [P3][P4][P5]. These could be leading indicators of an activity rebound not yet visible in contracts or congressional flows.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if the next observation shows government contracts and congressional net buying moving above baseline, with at least one of lobbying, solicitations, or material events also turning meaningfully positive while relative price strength remains positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The avoidance call is reinforced if contracts and congressional buying remain below baseline, the theme continues fading, and price strength weakens after having run ahead of activity [P1][P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: AI Infrastructure

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed and presently weak: congressional buying and federal grant opportunities are moderately positive, but material 8-K events and the regulatory pipeline are substantially negative, while lobbying and news-flow source readings are flat [P3]. Durability is poor because the theme is classified as fading with negative divergence, and the positive signals are not corroborated across most of the seven sources [P1][P3]. Price has remained strong relative to the market over 60 days even though activity trails price, indicating that market performance has run ahead of observable real-world support [P2][P4]. News velocity, acceleration, and wholly unscheduled coverage provide a possible near-term catalyst, but the evidence does not establish that this flow will persist [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号喜忧参半且整体偏弱：国会净买入和联邦拨款机会有所增强，但重大8-K事件和监管进程明显走弱，游说与新闻来源读数则持平[P3]。该主题已进入衰退阶段并出现负向背离，少数积极信号也未得到七类来源中多数来源的印证，因此持续性较差[P1][P3]。过去60天价格相对大盘仍然强劲，但现实活动落后于价格，说明市场表现已经跑在可观察的基本活动之前[P2][P4]。新闻速度与加速度形成潜在短期催化，但现有信息无法证明这种热度可以持续[P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government grant opportunities and congressional buying have picked up, but company disclosures and regulatory activity have weakened, while lobbying remains flat. Prices have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, suggesting enthusiasm has moved ahead of the supporting activity. News has recently accelerated, but there is not enough evidence that this momentum will last, so investors should avoid chasing the theme for now.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府拨款机会和国会议员买入有所增加，但企业重大披露与监管活动正在减弱，游说活动也没有增长。过去60天相关股票仍跑赢大盘，说明市场热情已经领先于现实支撑。近期新闻热度有所上升，但尚无足够证据表明这种势头能够持续，因此目前不宜追高。
assessments.dissent: The strongest opposing case is that the combined activity measure is accelerating, supported by positive congressional buying and federal grant opportunities, while news velocity and acceleration are both positive and all observed news is unscheduled [P3][P5]. These could represent early signals that broader activity will recover before current classifications adjust [P1].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if subsequent readings show activity moving ahead of price, the fading classification reverses, and several currently weak or flat sources—especially material events, regulation, lobbying, and solicitations—turn positive together [P1][P2][P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The avoid verdict is reinforced if relative price strength remains positive while activity continues to trail price, or if congressional buying and grant opportunities weaken without improvement in material events and regulation [P2][P3][P4].

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward forming activity-led themes—Memory/HBM & Storage, Payments & Fintech, and equal-weight Communication Services—while Cybersecurity, AI Agents, Gold Miners, and Robotics remain confirmed but mature; broad AI infrastructure, mega-cap tech, energy, crypto, and health themes are fading or price-led.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正转向由实体活动领先的早期主题——存储/HBM、支付金融科技及等权通信服务；网络安全、AI智能体、黄金矿业和机器人虽获确认但已成熟，而广泛AI基础设施、巨头科技、能源、加密及医疗主题正在衰退或仅由价格驱动。

Whether mature CONFIRMED_UP leaders—Cybersecurity, AI Agents & Applications, Gold Miners, and Robotics & Automation—retain confirmation or begin fading.
Whether negative-divergence AI, technology, energy, crypto, or health themes regain activity confirmation instead of remaining price-led.
Whether currently QUIET cyclicals, financials, defensives, industrials, or materials develop positive divergence, signaling broader rotation.
